# Run Model

## Prepare Data

```{r prepare-data}
tmp <- myd[
  ,
  .(
    pitch = pitch_median_tag,
    intensity = intensity_median_tag,
    speechrate = speechrate_tag,
    jitter = jitter_tag,
    shimmer = shimmer_tag,
    gender,
    age_pm_z,
    sci_pm_z,
    sun_vs_work = sunday_vs_workday,
    panas_pos_pm_z,
    panas_pos_pmc_z,
    panas_neg_pm_z,
    panas_neg_pmc_z,
    abf_pm_z = abf_all_pm_z,
    abf_pmc_z = abf_all_pmc_z,
    stressed_pm_z,
    stressed_pmc_z,
    workhour_pm_z = workinghours_daily_pm_z,
    workhour_pmc_z = workinghours_daily_pmc_z,
    code,
    day,
    study
  )
]

tmp <- tmp[complete.cases(tmp)]
```


## Fitting Model

```{r fit-model}
fit0 <- brms::brm(
  data = tmp,
  family = meta$brms_family,
  formula = brms::bf(mvbind(
    pitch,
    intensity,
    speechrate,
    jitter,
    shimmer
  ) ~ 0 +
    gender +
    age_pm_z +
    sci_pm_z +
    sun_vs_work +
    panas_pos_pm_z +
    panas_pos_pmc_z +
    panas_neg_pm_z +
    panas_neg_pmc_z +
    abf_pm_z +
    abf_pmc_z +
    stressed_pm_z +
    stressed_pmc_z +
    workhour_pm_z +
    workhour_pmc_z +
    abf_pmc_z:stressed_pmc_z +
    abf_pm_z:stressed_pm_z +
    (1 | p | code)) +
    brms::set_rescor(FALSE),
  prior = c(
    brms::set_prior("normal(0, 3)", class = "b", resp = "pitch"),
    brms::set_prior("normal(150, 100)", class = "b", coef = "genderfemale", resp = "pitch"),
    brms::set_prior("normal(150, 100)", class = "b", coef = "gendermale", resp = "pitch"),

    brms::set_prior("normal(0, 3)", class = "b", resp = "intensity"),
    brms::set_prior("normal(60, 5)", class = "b", coef = "genderfemale", resp = "intensity"),
    brms::set_prior("normal(60, 5)", class = "b", coef = "gendermale", resp = "intensity"),

    brms::set_prior("normal(0, 3)", class = "b", resp = "speechrate"),
    brms::set_prior("normal(3, 1)", class = "b", coef = "genderfemale", resp = "speechrate"),
    brms::set_prior("normal(3, 1)", class = "b", coef = "gendermale", resp = "speechrate"),

    brms::set_prior("normal(0, 3)", class = "b", resp = "jitter"),
    brms::set_prior("normal(2.8, 1)", class = "b", coef = "genderfemale", resp = "jitter"),
    brms::set_prior("normal(2.8, 1)", class = "b", coef = "gendermale", resp = "jitter"),

    brms::set_prior("normal(0, 3)", class = "b", resp = "shimmer"),
    brms::set_prior("normal(10, 3)", class = "b", coef = "genderfemale", resp = "shimmer"),
    brms::set_prior("normal(10, 3)", class = "b", coef = "gendermale", resp = "shimmer"),

    brms::set_prior("student_t(10, 0, 10)", class = "sd", resp = "pitch"),
    brms::set_prior("student_t(10, 0, 10)", class = "sd", resp = "intensity"),
    brms::set_prior("student_t(10, 0, 10)", class = "sd", resp = "speechrate"),
    brms::set_prior("student_t(10, 0, 10)", class = "sd", resp = "jitter"),
    brms::set_prior("student_t(10, 0, 10)", class = "sd", resp = "shimmer"),

    brms::set_prior("lkj(3)", class = "cor")
  ),
  # sample_prior = TRUE,
  save_model = "./main_cache/fit0.stan",
  file = "./main_cache/fit0",
  refresh = if (interactive()) 200 else 0,
  chains = meta$brms_chains,
  iter = meta$brms_iterations,
  seed = meta$seed
)
fit0 <- brms::add_criterion(fit0, "bayes_R2", file = "./main_cache/fit0")
```

```{r output-model}
summary(fit0)
plot(fit0)
```
